summary_1line: Markandeya recounts the Ikshvaku lineage to Kuvalaswa and describes the threat of the sand-dwelling Asura Dhundhu whom Kuvalaswa must slay.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Utanka stands before the aging king Vrihadaswa, describing the buried demon Dhundhu whose breath raises vast storms of sand across the desert.
In a barren sea of sands, the hidden Asura Dhundhu breathes beneath the earth, sending towering clouds of dust that darken the sun.
King Vrihadaswa places the crown upon Kuvalaswa before departing for the forest to live as an ascetic.
